quarterly_data.quarter: Eli Lilly press release: Lilly's Jaypirca (pirtobrutinib), the first-and-only (10-02-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Safety and guideline detail behind the first-line CLL/SLL approval of Jaypirca (pirtobrutinib): in the Phase 3 BRUIN CLL-313 trial, adverse reactions led to dose reductions in 3.6% and permanent discontinuation of Jaypirca in 4.3% of patients, and serious adverse reactions occurred in 28%. Lilly says Jaypirca is the first-and-only non-covalent BTK inhibitor recommended by the NCCN (company claim): Category 2A for treatment-naive adult CLL/SLL patients without del(17p) and a Category 1 preferred option for relapsed or refractory CLL/SLL after a covalent BTK inhibitor. The BRUIN program comprises four positive Phase 3 studies across lines of CLL/SLL (CLL-313, CLL-314 head-to-head versus ibrutinib, CLL-321 and CLL-322), and Lilly is studying Jaypirca in CLL/SLL in multiple Phase 3 studies.
quarterly_data.figure: BRUIN CLL-313 dose reductions 3.6%, discontinuation 4.3%, serious adverse reactions 28%; NCCN Category 2A (first line) and Category 1 preferred (post-covalent BTKi); four positive Phase 3 studies
